title: The ordinary singleton mate is invertible from normalized push evaluation
statement:
For every index n and any two ordinary left adjoints to source and target evaluation, the inverse mate of the fixed inverse-image/evaluation square is invertible. This is an assertion entirely in ordinary module categories; it has no resolutions or derived categories in its conclusion.

The sites, coefficient tower and fixed ordinary realization are as in lem-coef-semilinear-geometric-derived-evaluation. The precise Lean statement, with the ambient parameter context, is:

universe c v r
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
namespace WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)variable (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)
theorem geometricOrdinaryEvaluationMate_isIso [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] (n : ℕ)
    (L : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n) ⥤ Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ)
    (L' : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' (O.coefficients n) ⥤
      Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)
    (adj : L ⊣ evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n)
    (adj' : L' ⊣ evaluation.{c, v, max c v r}
      J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n) :
    IsIso ((mateEquiv adj adj').symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).inv)).natTrans

proof.text: Transpose the given ordinary push-evaluation isomorphism under the geometric adjunctions. Cancel the level pushforward of pull evaluation in ordinary_unit_evaluation. The resulting unit identity identifies its inverse mate with ordinaryPullEvaluation.inv.

Apply iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv to the singleton and geometric adjunctions. The conjugate of the singleton mate is the just-identified ordinary push-evaluation isomorphism. Apply conjugateEquiv_of_iso to reflect its invertibility.
